name: Paint Program for M5StickC Plus2
author: coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Professional paint program with Mini Joy C hat featuring full analog joystick control, 12 colors, 6 brush sizes, and smooth line drawing. Perfect for digital art creation on M5StickC Plus2.
features: 🎨 Professional paint program with smooth analog joystick control
🌈 12 vibrant colors with instant LED feedback
✏️ Smooth line drawing with no gaps or artifacts
🔄 Quick color cycling with joystick button
requirements: Mini Joy C Hat (required for joystick control)
usage_instructions: 1. Connect Mini Joy C hat to M5StickC Plus2
3. Power on - enjoy the demo flower artwork!
4. Press M5 button to start painting
5. Use joystick for smooth cursor movement
6. Quick press joystick to cycle colors
7. Hold joystick (1 sec) to enable drawing
8. Press BtnA to change brush size

technical_details.led_feedback: Real-time brush color on Joy C

version_history.1.3.0: Perfect control scheme: BtnA=brush size, Joy press=colors, Joy hold=draw mode
version_history.1.2.0: Added hold-to-draw system and demo artwork
version_history.1.1.0: Fixed cursor trails and improved analog control
version_history.1.0.0: Initial release with basic paint functionality
